where: after Cor. 1, "Il résulte du cor. l qu'on univers artinien"
scan: Il résulte du cor. 1 qu'un univers artinien est déterminé
tex: Il résulte du cor. l qu'on univers artinien
note: The print has "qu'un"; the TeX has "qu'on".
The typewriter digit 1 has been transcribed as the letter l. The reference is to Corollaire 1. If the 'old' of the previous finding is applied first, this one still matches.

where: proof of Lemme 1, "pour tout $g'\in S(g)$ de sorte que"
scan: on a φ(g') ∈ U pour tout g' ∈ S(g)
note: The argument concerns the maximal element h, so this should read S(h), as in the display that follows. The TeX keeps the printed S(g).
The function φ is the one of Lemme 1 (p. 208); Lemme 2 is stated only on p. 210. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
The verb should be "a" (has). The TeX keeps the printed "à".
The print omits the paragraph number; probably the present n° (6), where the artinian sets are introduced. The TeX keeps the omission.
